No patient investigation, therapeutic outcome, implant safety, quantum advantage or automated clinical decision is reported. A LETTER FROM THE THIRTY-FIRST RESEARCH FAMILY A predicted joint angle is not a recovered movement. The first flagship challenges memorized kinematics and device-version shifts. The second confronts unidentifiable latent muscle parameters. The third keeps 4D material deformation and mechanical work accountable. The fourth tests whether personalized intervals actually cover unseen synthetic individuals. The fifth transfers a frozen twin to a separate simulator and allows it to fail. The scientific platform is a sealed anonymous synthetic motion simulator, a programmable nonliving 4D material model, a neuromuscular proxy, independently calibrated angle and force witnesses, and a version-isolated receiving simulator. There is no implanted device, human patient experiment or validated personal rehabilitation prediction. The companion PDF preserves the 819-page research architecture: 30 dimensionally specified equations, 42 fully recomputable 3D analytic sensitivity grids, 82 chapters of six progressive Mechanism–Measurement–Refutation pages, 200 Research Gates and 33 unbuilt Phoenix prototypes. This notebook opens with nine title-led scientific descriptions and all five official 4D F151–F155 titles for accurate publication discovery. The research workflow couples traceable motion and material provenance, uncertainty-aware simulation, independent witnesses, adversarial baselines and a successor laboratory. FAMILY 31 OFFICIAL 4D FLAGSHIP TITLES / PUBLICATION DISCOVERY F151 | 4D Microrobotic Digital Twins of Post-Stroke Kinematics at the Limit Core research mechanism: held-out post-stroke-like kinematic trajectories and 4D microactuator version shift. Independent counterworld: a high-capacity model remembers the trajectory family, repeated subject identity or task sequence and only interpolates its own training library. Proposed blind test: seal new trajectory families, reverse task order, withhold actuator firmware and compare joint-angle prediction with an independent angle generator. Evidential limit: anonymous synthetic nonliving kinematic proxies, programmable material emulator and no medical treatment prediction. F152 | Multiscale Neuromuscular Digital Twins for 4D Microrobots at the Limit Core research mechanism: unidentifiable neural drive and muscle-force proxies across multiple scales. Independent counterworld: distinct neural and tendon parameters yield indistinguishable surface kinematics while the inferred muscle forces are artifacts of the chosen prior. Proposed blind test: blindly substitute two parameter sets with indistinguishable angles but different internal forces; test whether independent force sensors can distinguish them. Evidential limit: simulated activation and mechanical muscle proxies without recording humans or establishing neural recovery. F153 | Co-Simulation of Material Deformation and Motor Function at the Limit Core research mechanism: time-varying 4D material deformation interacting with surrogate motion. Independent counterworld: a weakly coupled model appears accurate only because it imposes a smoothed motion target, hides material hysteresis or consumes unreported external work. Proposed blind test: reverse the material activation history, independently integrate work and compare measured dummy displacement after hysteresis and held-out load changes. Evidential limit: nonliving 4D material and inert motor proxy co-simulations only, not tissue implantation or human gait. F154 | Individual Parameter Uncertainty in 4D Rehabilitation Digital Twins at the Limit Core research mechanism: personalization versus parameter non-identifiability and coverage under shift. Independent counterworld: narrow confidence bands reflect a strong prior, calibration leakage or optimizer convergence to one arbitrary parameter set, not independent evidence. Proposed blind test: swap latent parameter families and censor selected calibration windows; evaluate held-out prediction interval coverage and false certainty on synthetic new identities. Evidential limit: synthetic individual parameters and privacy-preserving offline simulations; not clinically personalized prescriptions. F155 | Cross-Platform Validation of 4D Microrobotic Rehabilitation Digital Twins at the Limit Core research mechanism: device and software transfer with unseen-task functional-proxy attribution.
